description: This file contains implementation of Orleans grains for stress testing, including internal grains such as StressTestGrain, ReentrantStressTestGrain, and related classes, with various remote method implementations and inter-grain messaging patterns.

classes.name: StressTestGrain
classes.description: Internal Orleans grain implementing stress testing behavior with various remote method calls and state management.

classes.name: ReentrantStressTestGrain
classes.description: A reentrant Orleans grain used for stress testing concurrent method calls and intergrain communication.

classes.name: ReentrantLocalStressTestGrain
classes.description: A reentrant, stateless Orleans grain used for local stress testing with concurrency features.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Handles grain activation, initializes labels, and logs activation.

methods.name: GetLabel
methods.description: Returns the current label of the grain.

methods.name: SetLabel
methods.description: Sets a new label for the grain.

methods.name: GetGrainReference
methods.description: Returns a reference to the grain itself.

methods.name: PingOthers
methods.description: Pings a list of other grains to retrieve their labels.

methods.name: LookUpMany
methods.description: Performs lookups for multiple grains and simulates silo addresses.

methods.name: Echo
methods.description: Echoes back the provided byte array.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: A simple ping method that does nothing.

methods.name: PingWithDelay
methods.description: Performs a delay to simulate work.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Send method, placeholder for message sending.

methods.name: PingMutableArray
methods.description: Recursively pings other grains with an array.

methods.name: PingImmutableArray
methods.description: Recursively pings other grains with an immutable array.

methods.name: PingMutableDictionary
methods.description: Recursively pings other grains with a mutable dictionary.

methods.name: PingImmutableDictionary
methods.description: Recursively pings other grains with an immutable dictionary.

methods.name: InterleavingConsistencyTest
methods.description: Performs an interleaving test with concurrent array and dictionary accesses for consistency.
